summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 14, 2026 press release announcing activation of 29 towers in October and an update on wholly owned energy subsidiary NuEnergy Africa Ltd. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed. The company cites over 5,000 towers under contract with Orange and MTN across eight countries, representing expected revenues exceeding US$900 million over five- to ten-year terms. NuEnergy is described as an internal platform for solar, battery-storage and hybrid power serving NuRAN's network, with possible future third-party energy services. Routine operational update, not a special situation; no deal terms, no risk-arb angle.
